items.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025
items.q: I think about like Herbie Hancock who is still touring.

ctx.x: Okay so there’s a couple of ways to answer that question. There’s the right way, which is just to say something that I hope will happen or something. Right? But then there’s the other way where you realize that like yes I’ve been doing this for 19 years but like I feel like this is still the beginning for me. Like when I think about the trajectory of like what it

means to be a composer, an artist, in the way that I am, I think about like Herbie Hancock who is still touring. And Chick Corea who was still touring until he passed. You know what I mean? I think about like people like that and I see, man I’m – right now, even though I’ve been doing it for 19 years and I’m 41, this is the oldest I’ve ever been, so I can feel old but like I can also see, man, there’s no way I can tell where things are going to be in 20 years let alone 10 years, let alone 5 years at this…
That’s going to be a memorable moment when that orchestra lines up and plays your music.
